document.title: Schneider Electric Product data sheet - LC1D09P7 (TeSys D contactor, 3P(3 NO), AC-3 <=440 V 9 A, 230 V AC coil)
document.pages: p.1 range/ratings/Uc; p.2 pole contact composition 3 NO, coil without built-in suppressor module, auxiliary contact composition 1 NO + 1 NC; p.3 auxiliary contacts type; p.6 Connections and Schema wiring diagram

modelingNotes: Manufacturer prints the reference as 'LC1D09P7' (no separators). This type uses the job's expectedOrderNumber 'LC1-D09P7'; the hyphen is a presentation separator for the same TeSys D / TeSys Deca part, not a successor substitution.

Terminal keys use the printed IEC numbers; the main poles also carry the dual marking read from the exact-part wiring diagram (datasheet p.6) and the B8/79 'LC1D09 to D150' scheme: 1=1/L1, 2=2/T1, 3=3/L2, 4=4/T2, 5=5/L3, 6=6/T3. Coil is A1/A2; auxiliary NO is 13-14; auxiliary NC is 21-22.

Coil suffix P7 = 230 V AC 50/60 Hz (Schneider B8/8 a.c. control-voltage table). Coil technology is 'Without built-in suppressor module'; on the a.c. supply only LC1D115/D150 coils have integral suppression, so this LC1D09 a.c. coil has no built-in RC/varistor. A1/A2 coil rating carries 230 V AC as nominal; the 50/60 Hz frequency is not reduced to a single scalar.

Auxiliary block is factory-integrated: mechanically linked 1 NO + 1 NC per IEC 60947-5-1; the NC is a mirror contact per IEC 60947-4-1. Signalling minimums 17 V / 5 mA. Auxiliary and main-pole endpoints are passive/application-dependent and are not marked universally required.

Main-pole ratings are conditional capabilities and are deliberately not flattened onto terminals: Ue <=690 V AC (25-400 Hz) / <=300 V DC; Ie AC-3 9 A <=440 V; AC-1 and conventional thermal current 25 A. Installed pole voltage varies by circuit (230/400 V per source locations), so no per-terminal nominal voltage is assigned to the main poles.

Coil energisation actuates all main poles and both auxiliary contacts (mechanical/functional), modeled with internal_relations 'actuates'. Contacts, coil and actuation never create permanent net joins; there are no fixed internal links.

Screw-clamp variant (P7): power and control screw clamp terminals 1...4 mm2, tightening 1.7 N.m. Spring/EverLink suffixes (LC1D093.., LC1D09A..) use different terminal technology and are out of scope. The device has no protective-earth, shield or communication terminal; panel/enclosure bonding is external.

connectionCoverage.notes: All12 labeled circuit endpoints are represented. Physical duplicate-access/clamping positions and any accessory suppression attachment geometry are not separately enumerated for the historical hardware edition; connection coverage is partial for those details. No extra terminal or fixed link is inferred. Optional external accessories remain separate.
